name: Quiet
overview: Scripture reveals that quietness is both an act of trust and a posture of the soul before God. Believers are called to hold their peace and be still, recognizing that the LORD fights on their behalf and is exalted through their calm confidence (Exodus 14:14; Psalms 46:10). Quietness also reflects a wise restraint in speech, guarding against sin through controlled lips (Proverbs 10:19), and fosters safety and freedom from fear (Proverbs 1:33). Like a weaned child content in its dependence, the soul finds rest and expectation only in God (Psalms 62:5; Psalms 131:2).
